scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
